scope: Bind both modeled guest RTC calendar/UIP/alarm reads to their retained selected VM clock; deterministic retired UTC2000 origin, exact saved clock continuation and target rebinding; explicit new private tags with legacy Wall-only admission. No full four-finding closure; idle/default/native/full replay remain open.

assumptions.assumption: Retired calendar uses fixed UTC2000 origin and owning clock nanoseconds, independent of host delay/timezone or foreign scopes.
assumptions.basis: Explicit retired mode is logical modeled time, PCF year field uses year2000 base; source service must be repeatable.
assumptions.dependent_result: Both RTC consumers and fresh/in-place file continuation.
assumptions.stress_test: Host delays/foreign scopes/timezones,whole/subsecond transitions,Gregorian leap/century bounds and wrap.
assumptions.falsification_probe: RTC observes host current date/timezone or another VM counter.

assumptions.assumption: Old private images lack the new selected-calendar contract; only legacy Wall restoration preserves their modeled contract.
assumptions.basis: RAXPCD01 and RAXSLI01 omit calendar input state and read live host time.
assumptions.dependent_result: Explicit new tags and side-effect-free Retired legacy rejection.
assumptions.stress_test: Exact legacy reencode/Wall restore and Retired full live-state denial; corrupt/unknown tags.
assumptions.falsification_probe: Old wall-backed private image silently enters a Retired target as a complete selected-calendar image.

assumptions.assumption: Clock mode is selected before owner construction and stopped restore commits incoming clock before guest entry.
assumptions.basis: Current VMM factory,ClockState admission and exclusive publication scope.
assumptions.dependent_result: Runtime-only retained clock references need no serialized pointer or per-RTC host offset.
assumptions.stress_test: Foreign preparation scope,existing destination epoch differs,pre-entry recheckpoint and1/2/4 contexts.
assumptions.falsification_probe: Restored RTC retains source/foreign owner or observes outgoing time during legitimate guest entry.

assumptions.assumption: Existing register formatting,SET semantics,PMU weekday stub and periodic polling policy remain existing device profiles.
assumptions.basis: Current PC/S5L RTC code; this group replaces calendar sources rather than invent physical chip timing.
assumptions.dependent_result: Compatible Wall behavior and same payload shapes behind explicit format versions.
assumptions.stress_test: PC BCD/binary12/24h,SET/UIP/alarms/IRQs and PMU byte sequence;full owning device tests.
assumptions.falsification_probe: Unchanged Wall profile formatting or saved mutable CMOS/I2C state changes.

change_surface.timing: Retained calendar source plus shared Gregorian UTC conversion
change_surface.devices: PC CMOS time/UIP/alarms and S5L PMU calendar; no host pointer serialization
change_surface.checkpoint: Private tag migration/admission,PC target binding retained,S5L detached target rebinding
change_surface.ISA_SMIR_C_ABI: No instruction/lowering or C ABI changes
change_surface.limits: Periodic interrupt frequency model,PC guest time setters,external event replay,default/idle/native and physical hardware remain separate open requirements

baseline.actual_parent_behavior: Two real RTC register reads produce host dates despite selected retired mode;0passed2failed.

time_arithmetic.precision: Existing thirds remain in VM clock; calendar exposes integer nanoseconds/date fields.

requirements.behavior: Both guest calendars retain selected clock identity and ignore host delay/timezone in Retired.
CMOS time,UIP,formatting and alarm comparisons use the same owned source.
PMU detached restoration retains destination owner and command progress.
New tags declare selected-calendar policy; legacy Wall reencode/import supported; Retired legacy rejects before publication.
Actual1/2/4 prepared-context source-free files preserve pre/post guest calendar reads,clock accounting and incoming epoch.
Exact owned commit in master, preserve unowned state/guests, remove idle owned build roots.

limits.item: Default/idle/periodic-IRQ policy,external-event/entropy replay and full native state remain incomplete; no full original finding closure.
Independent writers remain quiescent through stopped publication; native Intel and physical chip/device accuracy remain unverified.
Old retired PC/S5L calendar images reject; legacy Wall import remains supported; no lossless old retired host-calendar migration is claimed.
Existing PMU weekday/year bounds,PC guest-time writes/periodic polling/alarm-format limitations remain existing model behavior.
Prepared1/2/4 contexts do not prove architectural startup or weak-memory interleavings.

algorithmic_bounds: Each retained time read/bind and Gregorian conversion uses O(1) time/storage. Existing capture/media costs unchanged.
